senses.gloss: m. (יָשַׁן) allowing to dry up, leaving unused.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:3">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:3">IX</cite>), 3 <he>וכמה יִשּׁוּנָן</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 9:3">ib.</cite> Toh. XI, 16 <he>כמה הוא מְיַשְּׁנָן</he>) how long must they remain unused?
